# Vendored Swagger UI

These files are copied from `swagger-ui-dist` version `5.32.15`.

- Source package: `swagger-ui-dist@5.32.15`
- Project: https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui
- License: Apache License 2.0

The files are served below PBGui's `/app/` static mount so the API
documentation remains usable without third-party network requests.
